entries.aec174c83eb571e4: This business sells women's lingerie for body shaping (foundations and lingerie), body care cosmetics, custom-made insoles and dedicated shoes, and original supplements and health foods, through directly operated stores nationwide and EC sites. Directly operated stores also provide after-service such as body making using women's lingerie. Marco Co., Ltd., the core subsidiary, is responsible for it, and the non-consolidated subsidiary Maluke'er (Shanghai) International Trade Co., Ltd. sells women's lingerie and related products in China under agency contracts with local companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥18,589 million.
entries.b418a04c450138aa: The company is a holding company headquartered in Kita-ku, Osaka. The group consists of five companies in total: the company, three consolidated subsidiaries (Marco Co., Ltd., MISEL Co., Ltd. and ALTIQS Co., Ltd.) and one non-consolidated subsidiary. Consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026 numbered 1,720. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
